# Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio logos

* microsoft-copilot-logo-microsoft-365-copilot: retrieved 2026-10-29 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glincker/thesvg/main/public/icons/microsoft-365-copilot/default.svg (theSVG says brand icons are taken from the brand's own kit, unmodified; brand icons remain the trademark holder's property; codebase MIT).
* microsoft-power-platform-logo-copilot-studio: retrieved 2026-10-29 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DamoBird365/microsoft-cloud-icons/master/icons/power-platform/copilot-studio.svg (repository describes "official SVG and PNG icons"; trademark notice: all logos are property of Microsoft Corporation).
* Not downloaded from Microsoft directly: Microsoft's official Power Platform icon download (learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/guidance/icons) requires accepting terms in a browser. Microsoft permits these icons in architectural diagrams, training materials and documentation; do not crop, flip, rotate or distort them, and keep the product name close to the icon.
* Before merging, compare against Microsoft's official downloads if you can, and replace with the official file if it differs.
